column1: # The laptop jobs tools/resume_laptop_jobs.sh keeps alive (13 Oct 2026). One row per job, TAB-separated: name, command.
# The name is the job's row in probes/watch_jobs.tsv, which gives its log, its end marker (a finished job is never relaunched) and its process
# pattern. The command is started from the plan folder through tools/launch_outside_app.sh (WMI, outside the app's process tree). Every
# command here must resume by itself: done items are skipped (molecules with a result, APT files written, chain steps recorded).
# Add a row when a long job is launched; delete it when its outcome is recorded (as for watch_jobs.tsv).
